Mwangaza Community Water Project

The Mwangaza Community Water Project has a water storage capacity of 18,500 litres.

The project serves households in its surrounding community. Its storage infrastructure helps maintain water availability for community use.

The documented storage capacity is 18,500 litres. This figure refers to the project's total stated water storage capacity.

Baraka Community Water Project

The Baraka Community Water Project has a total water storage capacity of 12,000 litres.

The project serves households in the Baraka community.

Its storage infrastructure supports water distribution to nearby households.

Baraka Community Water Project is separate from the Mwangaza Community Water Project.

Mwangaza Community Water Project — Operations

The Mwangaza Community Water Project serves households in its surrounding community.

The project conducts water quality testing every month to monitor the condition of its supplied water.

Storage tank inspections are conducted quarterly to identify structural problems and maintenance requirements.

The distribution network consists of pipelines connecting the storage infrastructure to surrounding households.

Mwangaza Community Water Project — Funding Information

The initial construction of the Mwangaza Community Water Project was funded through a county development grant and community contributions.

The project received financial support for its initial infrastructure development.

This document does not specify the project's annual water treatment budget or its recurring water treatment expenditure.
